This article is a stub. Sycom, Inc., of Orange, California, made the Pasar audible swim pacing
system and the [Pacedyne](../equipment/common/pace-clock/pacedyne.md) pace clock, which [Seagull
Enterprises](seagull.md) distributed from 1977.

See the [vendors](index.md) register for the companies this wiki covers.
